repo.description:
## Impact

The Filter and Switch nodes compiled user-supplied regex patterns with `new RegExp()` and executed them synchronously on the worker thread without any complexity validation or execution timeout. A crafted pattern could block the worker for an extended period per data item processed, delaying other executions on the same worker for as long as the regex ran.

## Patches

The issue has been fixed in n8n versions 1.123.69, 2.33.4, and 2.34.1. Users should upgrade to one of these versions or later to remediate the vulnerability.

## Workarounds

If upgrading is not immediately possible, administrators should consider the following temporary mitigations:
- Restrict n8n instance access to fully trusted users only.
- Audit existing workflows for Filter or Switch nodes using regex conditions and review the patterns configured in them.

These workarounds do not fully remediate the risk and should only be used as short-term mitigation measures.
repo.summary: ReDoS in Filter and Switch Node Regex Matching Allows Worker Denial of Service
